items.prompt: לֹא שָׁתָה הַפָּר מִן־הַמַּיִם כִּי מָרִים הֵם
items.answer: The ox did not drink of the water, for it was bitter.

items.prompt: אֵלֶּה הַפָּרוֹת הָרָעוֹת אֲשֶׁר רָאָה הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַיְאֹר
items.answer: These are the ill-favoured kine which the king saw by the river.
Man has dominion over the beasts and the fish.

items.prompt: הֵמָּה הַשָּׂרִים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעָם
items.answer: Those are the princes and the mighty men whom the king set over the people.
I said to this people, righteous are ye.

items.prompt: ראה המלך בחלום את־הפרות הטבות על־היאר
items.answer: The king saw in a dream the goodly kine by the river.

data.pointed: רָאָה הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם אֶת־הַפָּרוֹת הַטֹּבוֹת עַל־הַיְאֹר

items.answer: Yahweh remembers that we are dust.
items.explain: Could also be pointed זְכֹר, 'remember, O Yahweh'.

items.prompt: I remember (perf.) the songs which I heard in the temple.
These (are) the asses which we slew.
We sat on the hills two days.
Bread he ate and water he drank.
The just are as the stars which (are) in the firmament.
He took oxen and cows and horses and asses.
We heard the wolves in the evening.
I counted the stars which God has set in the heavens.
items.answer: סָפַרְתִּי אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם

items.prompt: God gave me a new song.
